section_title: Cooperation involving the private sector > Private sector information sharing

propositions.proposition: 美国《爱国者法案》第314b条允许金融机构共享客户或交易信息以协助反洗钱/反恐融资合规，并为参与机构提供安全港免除法律责任。
source_quotes: 314b allows financial institutions to share customer or transactional information with each other to assist with AML/CFT compliance.
It provides participating organizations with a safe harbor from legal liability.

trigger_or_context: 金融机构希望共享信息以协助合规
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 法律允许共享信息并提供安全港
outcomes_or_paths: 协助反洗钱/反恐融资合规

evidence_spans.quote: 314b allows financial institutions to share customer or transactional information with each other to assist with AML/CFT compliance.
It provides participating organizations with a safe harbor from legal liability.

propositions.proposition: 英国《2023年经济犯罪与公司透明度法案》允许两家受监管机构共享信息，并豁免民事责任和保密义务。
source_quotes: In the UK, the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 provides the legal means for two regulated organizations to share information with each other. Like Section 314b in the US, the act exempts such disclosures from civil liability and confidentiality obligations.

trigger_or_context: 受监管机构希望共享信息
basis_or_condition: 英国《2023年经济犯罪与公司透明度法案》
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 法律允许信息共享并提供豁免
outcomes_or_paths: 豁免民事责任和保密义务

evidence_spans.quote: In the UK, the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 provides the legal means for two regulated organizations to share information with each other. Like Section 314b in the US, the act exempts such disclosures from civil liability and confidentiality obligations.

propositions.proposition: 新加坡COSMIC平台允许金融机构在客户出现红旗标志且达到特定阈值时共享信息。
source_quotes: Other examples of private-to-private sector sharing exist globally. For example, in Singapore, COSMIC is a digitally secure platform that allows financial institutions to share information. When a customer exhibits “red flags” indicating potential financial crime concerns, financial institutions can share information if certain thresholds are met.

trigger_or_context: 客户出现红旗标志 indicating potential financial crime concerns
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 金融机构可以共享信息

evidence_spans.quote: Other examples of private-to-private sector sharing exist globally. For example, in Singapore, COSMIC is a digitally secure platform that allows financial institutions to share information. When a customer exhibits “red flags” indicating potential financial crime concerns, financial institutions can share information if certain thresholds are met.

propositions.proposition: 欧盟(EU)2024/1624号法规第75条允许经国家监管机构批准的跨境信息共享伙伴关系，并要求在处理个人信息前进行数据保护影响评估。
source_quotes: In the EU, Article 75 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 allows organizations to take part in cross-border information sharing partnerships, if their national supervisor approves it. Organizations may share information about customer identity, business relationships, transactions, and customer risk factors.
National supervisor approval under Article 75 requires the partnership to carry out a data protection impact assessment before processing personal information.

trigger_or_context: 组织希望参与跨境信息共享伙伴关系
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 允许参与伙伴关系并共享信息；要求进行数据保护影响评估
outcomes_or_paths: 共享客户身份、业务关系、交易和风险因素信息
进行数据保护影响评估

evidence_spans.quote: In the EU, Article 75 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 allows organizations to take part in cross-border information sharing partnerships, if their national supervisor approves it. Organizations may share information about customer identity, business relationships, transactions, and customer risk factors.
National supervisor approval under Article 75 requires the partnership to carry out a data protection impact assessment before processing personal information.

propositions.proposition: 组织在加入私营部门信息共享安排前应仔细考虑当地数据保护法和客户保密义务。
source_quotes: Organizations looking to join private-to-private sector information sharing arrangements should carefully consider their obligations under local data protection legislation and customer confidentiality requirements within their organization.

trigger_or_context: 组织考虑加入私营部门信息共享安排
basis_or_condition: 当地数据保护法和客户保密义务

evidence_spans.quote: Organizations looking to join private-to-private sector information sharing arrangements should carefully consider their obligations under local data protection legislation and customer confidentiality requirements within their organization.

propositions.proposition: 如果继续，组织应分配适当资源并制定政策和程序来管理信息共享活动。
source_quotes: If proceeding, organizations should assign appropriate resources and develop policies and procedures to govern the activity.
